Chemistry in the News Presentation.

1) Prepare a one side single space paper on your chemical. Include a picture of the chemical structure, name and molecular weight at the top of the page and write 4-6 paragraphs under that. (Who discovered it? When? What does it do? Where is it found? How is it made? etc etc etc). Put your name on your paper. Print a Hard Copy for my records.

2) Prepare a 4-5 minute presentation consisting of 5-6 slides. If you aim for four slides and four minutes of talking you will do great.
Chapter 11 Review Packet (must complete for credit)

Periodic Table. Color according to your key using textbook pages 168-169 as a reference. Add the arrows and labels from Fig. 6.24 page 182 (Periodic Trends) to your periodic table. You may use this diagram during the test. Therefore do not add any additional information.

Aufbau Diagram, Figure 5.5, page 135
Electromagnetic Spectrum Diagram, Figure 5.8, page 139
Use ruler, pencil, colors, draw straight lines, make it beautiful.
